title: Five-year follow-up of corneal endothelial cell density after transscleral ab interno glaucoma gel stent implantation
indication: Mild to moderate open-angle glaucoma with insufficiently controlled IOP or intolerance to topical therapy; ab interno XEN45 gel stent with intra-Tenon mitomycin C, alone (solo group) or combined with phacoemulsification through the cataract ports (combined group); 22 of 69 solo-group eyes were pseudophakic at baseline

groups.description: Solo XEN45 gel stent implantation (solo surgery group)
XEN45 gel stent implantation combined with phacoemulsification cataract surgery (combined surgery group)

exclusions.what: Tab3 'Median' and 'Median % change' columns (C2, C3, C5, C6, C8, C9)
exclusions.reason: medians and median percent changes are not admissible (protocol 1.0.0, Inclusion 3)
pooled total of the solo and combined groups (same eyes); the two procedure groups are extracted separately

exclusions.what: Tab1 R12 central endothelial cell count
Tab4 proportions of eyes with loss above thresholds
exclusions.reason: proportions of eyes (counts), not ECD means
not tabulated by visit; only central ECD is in Table 3

notes: Design (Methods): all eyes had a preoperative baseline visit and a last postoperative visit in 2021; yearly interim visits were optional (used by 58 of 155 eyes), so each yearly mean is over a different subset of eyes (per-visit n in the cells).
Table 1 footnote: 13 of 47 phakic solo-group eyes had cataract surgery between the XEN45 procedure and the postoperative visit.
Both arms are XEN45 glaucoma surgery without a declared experimental arm; both recorded as control (procedure context glaucoma, combined cataract surgery in the combined group).

series.notes: Table 3 'Mean' column of the solo surgery group: mean (95% CI, n) of central ECD (Konan CellChek XL); rows labelled 1 to 5 years are yearly data bins (first to fifth postoperative year, Statistical methods)
